verdict.rationale: Circle is API-first and can be driven without a UI. It offers REST APIs and SDKs (circle-docs-15), an official CLI covering wallets, transfers, bridging and contract execution from a single command interface (circle-docs-24, circle-probe-4), and idempotency keys for safe retries (circle-docs-25). Webhooks support event-driven reaction (circle-docs-10), and agent wallets can transact autonomously within defined policies (circle-docs-19). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI/pipeline usage, non-interactive or service-credential auth for the CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
